title: Chicago's Dark Side: Ghosts, Gangsters, and True Crime Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover Chicago’s dark side on a chilling 2-hour walking tour. Strolling just under 2 miles at an easy pace, we reveal stories of gangsters, tragedies, and restless spirits hidden behind the city’s glamorous façade. Hear of hidden mob headquarters, psychopaths in plain sight, and disasters like the Iroquois Fire and Eastland Disaster. 

Join us in exploring historic interiors where gangsters once gathered and ghosts are said to linger. Along the way, explore the roots of ghost lore—are they real sightings or tricks of architecture? Decide for yourself if Chicago’s most haunted tales are fact or fiction. Perfect for fall nights and curious minds, this tour blends true crime, gangster history, and ghost stories into an unforgettable experience.
